title: Cosserat-Rod Modeling of a Soft Tentacle Robot
summary: Modeling soft robots with Cosserat rod theory and validating the model on a soft tentacle prototype built in the lab.

title: 3D-Printed Soft Robots from Soft PLA
summary: Soft robots made directly from Soft PLA by FDM 3D printing: fabrication methods, printing parameters and simulation of the designs in SOFA.

title: Bio-Inspired Continuum Robot for Mini-Buggy Stability
summary: A continuum robot mounted on a mini buggy helps keep the vehicle stable, inspired by the way a mouse moves.
supervisor: Dr. Masoud Goharimanesh; Dr. Ali Koochi

title: Cooperative Continuum Robots with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Two continuum robots working side by side grasp and move an object together; the cooperation is learned with reinforcement learning. Prototypes are 3D-printed and the study continues in SOFA.
keywords: Continuum robots; Reinforcement learning; Cooperative manipulation

title: PneuNet Soft Actuators Optimized with the Taguchi Method
summary: Silicone soft robots driven by PneuNet actuators with a special chamber geometry; Taguchi design of experiments is used to improve their performance.

title: Fork-Joint Continuum Robot without a Soft Body
summary: A new continuum robot built only from four-pronged (fork) joints, with no soft backbone. An accurate prototype has been built and the design is tested in MuJoCo.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Soft-Robot Mechanics
summary: Solving the governing equations of soft robots with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and verifying the results with SOFA.

title: PINN Research (alumni collaboration)
summary: Continuing research on physics-informed neural networks with the lab after graduation.

title: AI Models and Machine Vision
summary: Artificial-intelligence models and machine vision for robotic perception.

title: Building a 3D Printer
summary: Designing and building a 3D printer for the lab: frame, motion system, electronics and firmware.

title: Cartesian Plotter for Cutting and Making PCBs
summary: Electronic circuits and a Cartesian plotter that can also cut and make printed-circuit boards.

title: Amazing Hand — 3D-Printed Robotic Hand
summary: A 3D-printed robotic hand: printing the parts, assembly and, finally, control of the fingers.

title: 3D Printer Funded by Benefactors
summary: The cost of building a 3D printer was donated through the Benefactors' Foundation Supporting the University of Torbat Heydarieh, by Eng. Ghazanfari. The printer is used alongside the lab's other fabrication equipment.
